decisions.reason: Having already been retained once, this gas-focused comparison tool now carries additional sunk development and public-commitment weight while still fitting closely enough to the firm's core tariff and market-data business to justify continuation.

This electricity tariff calculator is highly aligned with the firm's core calculation, data and platform capabilities, and its continued standalone presentation strengthens management's tendency to stay committed unless failure is unmistakable.

Although more of a supporting application than a flagship product, it underpins the firm's stated integrated-platform direction and prior investment plus visible market presence make withdrawal less likely than continued support.
